name: Fairmont Fujairah Beach Resort

address.street: Mina Al Fajer - Fujairah - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: Where Arabian heritage meets pristine coastline - this resort sits on the only emirate facing the Indian Ocean, offering a completely different UAE experience away from the desert cities.
whats_special: Located on Fujairah's dramatic coastline, this resort boasts the UAE's most pristine beaches with crystal-clear waters perfect for diving and snorkeling. Unlike other emirates, Fujairah's unique geography features the Hajar Mountains plunging directly into the sea, creating breathtaking backdrops and cooler temperatures year-round.
pro_tip: Book diving excursions to explore the coral reefs just offshore - Fujairah has some of the best underwater visibility in the region, often exceeding 30 meters.
dont_miss: Visit the historic Fujairah Fort, one of the oldest castles in the UAE, and take a day trip to the nearby Snoopy Island for world-class snorkeling. The Friday Market in nearby Masafi offers authentic local crafts and the famous Masafi pottery.
pros: Pristine beachfront location with stunning views of the Gulf of Oman
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with traditional treatments
Multiple dining venues offering diverse international cuisines
Excellent water sports and recreational activities
cons: Remote location requiring travel time to major attractions
Limited nightlife and entertainment options in surrounding area
